//: Stylelint for loopy's styles: src/loopy.css, src/print.css and every page's <style> block (tools/lint/check.mjs runs it; CI too). The Baseline rule keeps the CSS to what every current browser has (Baseline newly available, data from web-features), so a child's Safari never meets a property it does not know. The ignored properties are safe fall-throughs: user-select is always written with its -webkit- twin, accent-color and resize fall back to the browser's own look, text-wrap: pretty to normal wrapping, ui-monospace to the next font in the list. Hard-coded colours are not a Stylelint rule on purpose: print styles are black on white, bank notes and coins have their own colours and var(--x, #fff) fallbacks are fine; tools/review.py and improve-ui watch the theme variables.
